name: @schoolos/integrations
description: SchoolOS interoperability adapters, starting with OneRoster 1.2 roster sync from a bulk CSV export (as files or one ZIP) or a REST server: preview, identity linking, safe apply, delta sync runs with per-file cursors, stored sync state and run history (in memory or a Durable Object), a sync schedule and integration health. A library, not a deployable Worker.
